components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is prepended, after a single space, to the lastName to compose
            the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized the same way (trimmed,
            whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: An optional second line of the owner's structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When supplied it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to the composed
            'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, but the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are preferred
            when present. Returned as the normalized composed address — the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). On create a national number is accepted and
            normalized (assuming country code '+61' when none is given).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. When omitted on creation it defaults
            to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it determines the
            owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name and postcode (they are the same household); it bypasses the household
            duplicate block and creates the owner as a declared household member, which is never
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is deterministic and shared regardless
            of this flag. Write-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived at read time from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and lastName, space-separated (e.g. 'DR who'),
                or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans — the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time; the raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the first eight upper-cased hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized (E.164) telephone concatenated with lastName.
                Assigned at creation; there is no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits contained
                in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 6
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic identifier for the owner's household — the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and postcode. Every owner has one,
                so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's identity — the 64-character lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where the email segment is empty when
                absent. Duplicate detection is keyed on this value, so creating an owner whose identity
                key matches an existing non-deleted owner is rejected with 409 unless 'sharesHousehold'
                is set.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:

The change is implemented and green. Summary of what I did, following the existing `bulkSignupWarning` pattern:

1. **`AssignCapacityWarning.java`** (new) — a pipeline function that snapshots the count of existing owners in the owner's city (case-insensitive, collapsed whitespace, matching `EnsureCityCapacity`) and sets `capacityWarning = true` when that count is 40–49 inclusive.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `assignCapacityWarning` step into the create pipeline (inside the transaction, after `assignBulkSignupWarning`, before `assignPossibleDuplicate`), so it runs after `BuildOwner` populates the entity and before `SaveOwner`.

3. **`Owner.java`** — added the `capacityWarning` field (`@Column(name = "capacity_warning")`) with getter/setter.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added `capacityWarning` (boolean, read-only) to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct maps it by name.

5. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `capacity_warning BOOLEAN` column.

The hard rejection at 50 (`EnsureCityCapacity`) is untouched; since it runs earlier in the pipeline, the count seen by the warning step is always below 50. `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
